decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while setting up its own win conditions. By utilizing cards like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to control the board state, as well as disruptive creatures like Lavinia and Orcish Bowmasters, the deck aims to delay the opponent's game plan and gain card advantage with Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value by allowing the player to recast key cards from the graveyard. With access to powerful spells like Demonic Tutor and Time Walk, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a slow, controlling fashion.

The deck focuses on using powerful control spells and disruption to slow down the opponent while generating card advantage and maintaining board presence. It utilizes counterspells like Force of Will, card draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time, removal spells like Fatal Push, and disruption like Wasteland and Strip Mine. The inclusion of Lurrus as a companion allows for additional recursion of key pieces from the graveyard. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by controlling the game until it can establish a winning position.

The deck focuses on assembling the Coveted Jewel combo using cards like Mishra's Workshop and Paradoxical Outcome to generate mana and draw cards. It includes powerful cards like Time Vault and Ancestral Recall to further support the combo. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the combo pieces, generate mana efficiently, and use powerful artifact abilities to gain an advantage and win the game.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage. It utilizes powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to gain tempo advantage, combined with disruptive counter magic in Force of Will and Spell Pierce. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Strip Mine to control the board and keep opponent threats in check. With a compact and versatile card selection, this deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and come out on top through a combination of resource denial and card advantage.

The deck revolves around utilizing artifacts and mana acceleration to generate a large amount of mana, then using cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Tinker to draw cards and search for combo pieces such as Time Vault and The One Ring. Using cards like Manifold Key, Voltaic Key, and Karn, the Great Creator to untap key artifacts and achieve infinite turns or generate a substantial advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor to protect the combo and disrupt opponents' strategies.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize powerful artifacts like Coveted Jewel and The One Ring to generate mana and draw cards, while also using cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Tinker to create powerful combos. The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Mishra's Workshop and Mana Crypt, as well as controlling the board with cards like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Karn, the Great Creator adds versatility and the potential for game-changing plays.

The deck focuses on using disruptive spells and control elements to dominate the game, deploying efficient removal like Fatal Push and counterspells like Force of Will. It takes advantage of card advantage with Ancestral Recall and powerful tutors like Demonic Tutor, while also utilizing the graveyard with cards like Nihil Spellbomb. The deck aims to control the game with tempo plays, card advantage, and disruption until it can close out the game with a powerful threat like Lurrus of the Dream-Den or overwhelming the opponent with its efficient control tools.

This deck focuses on utilizing hatebear creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying constant pressure with aggressive creatures. The deck also aims to control the board with cards like Archon of Emeria and Chancellor of the Annex, while using cards like Anointed Peacekeeper to slow down the opponent's aggression. The deck also includes mana acceleration through cards like Black Lotus and Moxen to quickly deploy threats. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly closing out the game with efficient creatures and spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful graveyard recursion abilities to quickly swarm the board with aggressive creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Vengevine. By manipulating the graveyard with cards like Life from the Loam and Once Upon a Time, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats while disrupting their artifacts with cards like Null Rod and Collector Ouphe. The deck's mana base is designed to support this strategy with lands like Gaea's Cradle and Bazaar of Baghdad providing additional resources and card advantage.

The key strategy of this deck is to utilize cards that can be used from the graveyard to quickly build a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. By focusing on cards like Narcomoeba, Ichorid, and Prized Amalgam, the deck aims to quickly fill the battlefield with creatures that can be brought back easily. Additionally, the use of cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder allow for effective card selection and graveyard manipulation, while disruption is provided through cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation. Overall, the deck aims to win through a fast and aggressive combo strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play quickly and efficiently. It also includes a control element with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, as well as disruptive planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils and Oko, Thief of Crowns. The strategy is to control the game while also ramping into powerful threats, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a combination of speed and disruption. The deck aims to assert dominance over the opponent through a combination of powerful creatures and control elements.

The main strategy of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining board presence and applying pressure through aggressive creatures like Deathrite Shaman and Collector Ouphe. The deck also utilizes powerful blue spells like Force of Will and Ancestral Recall to control the game and draw cards. It aims to outmaneuver the opponent with a mix of disruption, card advantage, and efficient threats, while using cards like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Leovold, Emissary of Trest to further disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck is designed to be versatile and adaptable in different matchups.

The deck focuses on using powerful artifacts like Mishra's Workshop and Nettlecyst to ramp up and overwhelm opponents quickly. By utilizing cards like Sphere of Resistance and Thorn of Amethyst to slow down opponents, along with disruptive artifacts like Null Rod and Trinisphere, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up its own board presence with creatures like Stonecoil Serpent and Patchwork Automaton. Additionally, cards like Crucible of Worlds and Wasteland provide additional disruption and resource denial, giving the deck a strong aggro advantage in the matchup.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo pieces needed to cast Doomsday and win the game. It includes powerful draw spells and tutors to find key cards like Thassa's Oracle and Demonic Consultation, as well as disruption spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo. The deck aims to efficiently dig through the deck to set up a winning Doomsday pile and uses various cantrips to sculpt the perfect hand. The strategy revolves around carefully planning out the Doomsday pile to secure the win in a single turn.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through countermagic and removal spells while generating card advantage with cantrips and card draw spells. The goal is to control the game and outvalue the opponent with efficient spells and powerful threats like Fatal Push and Psychic Frog. With the addition of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck gains additional grinding power and resilience against removal-heavy strategies. The use of powerful restricted Vintage cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk further solidifies the deck's control and advantage-generating gameplay.

This deck focuses on utilizing disruptive creatures and powerful spells to control the board and outvalue the opponent. By using cards like Deathrite Shaman, Collector Ouphe, and Psychic Frog, it aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing its own threats. The deck also includes versatile spells like Abrupt Decay, Assassin's Trophy, and Force of Will to deal with various threats. With a mix of disruption, card advantage, and efficient threats, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy in order to secure a victory.
